propositions: tests/unit/test_build_provenance.py rebuilds identical clean-source wheel and sdist artifacts across four separate tests, causing redundant build invocations per test session
session-scoped per-worker immutable artifact fixtures can be created once using tmp_path_factory and safely shared read-only across multiple test consumers
wheel-from-sdist, sdist-content, and install-from-sdist tests can reuse shared prerequisite artifacts while retaining their original archive-content and provenance assertions
install-from-sdist and empty-env-failure tests require distinct real builds (function-scoped extraction and env-unset rebuild, or real failing build) that cannot mutate shared inputs
deterministic build-call counting via subprocess seam validates exactly one successful prerequisite build per pytest worker/session and catches duplicate-build or missing-COMMIT defects
